title: Errors and pending UI
summary: Keep initial loading, route errors, and independent fetcher errors distinct.

sections.title: Route modules
sections.body: Re-export fallback and boundary components beside handlers. The error boundary gets an Error prop. Error messages are rendered when no boundary is provided.

sections.title: Successful undefined data
sections.body: A loader can return undefined successfully. That still counts as loaded and should not remount the fallback during later revalidation. Use fetcher.state for button loading indicators.

sections.title: Returned errors and Responses
sections.body: Return an Error for failure or allow a rejected promise to be normalized. A Response carrying Location redirects internally. Other Response values are passed through; the client server transport expects JSON response bodies.
